title: Saudi Arabian Beef Brisket Hash
description: A flavorful and hearty Saudi Arabian dish made with slow-cooked beef brisket and hash browned with aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef brisket until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the brisket from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the aromatic spices, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hash to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Return the brisket to the pot and add the lemon juice.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake the brisket at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Let the brisket rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
